en: The Section on the Training Rules (Sekhiyakaṇḍa)
The Training Rule on Standing to Defecate.
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks were defecating and urinating while standing...
[as before] ... "The training is to be observed: 'I shall not, when not ill, defecate or urinate while standing.
One who is not ill must not defecate or urinate while standing.
If one who is not ill, standing out of disrespect, voids excrement or urine, there is an offense of wrong-doing. There is no offense if it is unintentional … [and so forth] …
The thirteenth training rule is concluded.
